methods.body: const w=d.w,h=d.h;if(this.amount<=0)return;let s=Math.max(1,Math.floor(this.seed));const rnd=()=>{s=s*16807%2147483647;return s/2147483647};const n=Math.min(26,Math.round(6+this.amount*90));for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=w*(.18+rnd()*.64),y=h*(.2+rnd()*.6);const r=(6+rnd()*26)*(.5+this.amount*3);const heat=rnd();const g=d.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);if(heat>.86){g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(240,90,200,0.85)");g.addColorStop(.5,"rgba(150,80,240,0.55)")}else if(heat>.6){g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(80,140,250,0.8)");g.addColorStop(.5,"rgba(80,170,250,0.45)")}else{g.addColorStop(0,"rgba(110,200,250,0.6)");g.addColorStop(.5,"rgba(120,210,250,0.3)")}g.addColorStop(1,"rgba(120,210,250,0)");d.fillStyle=g;d.beginPath();d.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);d.fill()}

methods.body: const w=this.view==null?0:this.view.width;const n=Math.max(1,Math.round(this.cols));const g=this.gap;const colW=(w-g*(n-1))/n;const kids=this.laid();const out=[];for(let k=sCol;k<sCol+span2;k++)y=Math.max(y,bottom[k]);if(y<bestY-.5){bestY=y;bestJ=j;bestCol=sCol}}}if(bestJ<0){bestJ=0;bestCol=0;bestY=bottom[0]}const i=unplaced[bestJ];unplaced.splice(bestJ,1);const methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";const crossOf=c=>{if(flexing(c))return{lead:0,extent:c[crossSize]};const fc=c.footprint();return{lead:axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x,extent:fc[crossSize]}};let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,crossOf(c).extent);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"){const co=crossOf(c);const leadC=co.lead;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-co.extent)/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-co.extent;else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})
